notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 federation execution and member listing services. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and logical-time implementation. It verifies NotConnected boundaries, multiple federation execution reports, member reports, missing-execution reports, evoked versus immediate callback boundaries, disconnect cleanup of queued reports, post-resignation membership, and destroyed-execution reporting without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador listFederationExecutions and listFederationExecutionMembers with FederateAmbassador federation and member report callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador federation listing and FederateAmbassador report declarations
